# Remove-ZbxScript

## SYNOPSIS

Removes scripts.

## SYNTAX

```
Remove-ZbxScript [-InputObject] <ZabbixReference<ZabbixScript>[]> [-Force] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

A script is a command, webhook or URL users run from a host or event menu, or an action runs as an operation. The Remove-ZbxScript cmdlet deletes the scripts given to -InputObject (names, ids or piped objects) with script.delete, all in one call when the pipeline ends. It asks for confirmation first unless -Confirm:$false or -Force is given, and -WhatIf lists what would be deleted. It writes nothing, and needs a connection made with Connect-ZbxServer.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Delete a script

```powershell
Remove-ZbxScript -InputObject 'Reboot host' -Confirm:$false
```

Deletes the script Reboot host. -Confirm:$false skips the prompt the command shows by default.

### Example 2: Preview deleting the scripts a search finds

```powershell
Get-ZbxScript -Name 'Reboot*' | Remove-ZbxScript -WhatIf
```

Lists the scripts whose names start with Reboot that the command would delete, and deletes nothing.
